item.title: Iranian Mission in Vienna: Aggression cannot be erased by resolutions
item.description: London, IRNA – Iranian Permanent Mission to International Organizations in Vienna criticized the legal and technical foundations of the International Atomic Energy Agency's reports on Iran, calling on the IAEA Board of Governors to address the consequences of military attacks against the country's nuclear facilities.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86326246/Iran-s-Mission-in-Vienna-Aggression-Cannot-Be-Erased-by-Resolutions

London, IRNA – Iranian Permanent Mission to International Organizations in Vienna criticized the legal and technical foundations of the International Atomic Energy Agency's reports on Iran, calling on the IAEA Board of Governors to address the consequences of military attacks against the country's nuclear facilities.

item.title: Rights groups call for release of detained Shia clerics in Bahrain
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Twenty human rights organizations have called for the release of detainees and the dropping of charges related to peaceful religious activities in Bahrain, expressing concern over the mass trial of Shia clerics and allegations of torture and forced confessions.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – Twenty human rights organizations have called for the release of detainees and the dropping of charges related to peaceful religious activities in Bahrain, expressing concern over the mass trial of Shia clerics and allegations of torture and forced confessions.
